title: release-cutover-checklist-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-23-noah
body:
Daily scratchpad for 2026-03-23 release cutover (prod).

Context:
- Release: 2026.03.23 (canary -> grad -> prod).
- Primary owner: Noah Kim (release eng).
- Oncall SRE: Aisha Rao.
- Rollback owner: Jordan Lee.
- Win condition: successful model routing switch, no user-facing latency/regressions > 5% and error budget within SLOs.

Timeline / runbook (live notes):
- 08:00 - Pre-cutover sync (15m) w/ eng, sres, product. Confirm tickets + infra green.
  - Attendees: release-eng, sres, model-onboarding, product-ux.
  - Confirmed: canary build id: build-2026.03.23-rc2, k8s image sha: sha256:abcd...

Pre-cutover checks (must be green):
- [x] All release PRs merged (RELEASE-482).
- [x] DB migrations reviewed and backwards-compatible.
- [x] Smoke tests pass on staging (staging smoke run at 07:30 PASSED).
- [ ] Verify alerting thresholds for new endpoints (TODO: update metric filters).
- [x] Canary infra reserved (dedicated pool scaled to 6 pods).
- [ ] Confirm canary dataset replay script will run (need to QA one more time).

Canary deploy steps (expected 09:00):
1) Deploy canary to canary namespace (k8s namespace: canary-prod-2026-03-23).
2) Run canary traffic at 2% for 30m. Observability: latency P95, error rate, token throughput.
3) Run targeted evals (prompt-suite v3) against canary.
4) If no regressions, increase to 20% for 30m.

Notes during canary (live):
- 09:10: initial P95 latency up 8% on short-chat endpoint. Investigating - likely batching config difference.
- 09:18: temporarily reduce concurrency on canary pods to 8 -> P95 back to +2%. Need follow-up to update autoscaling policy.

Backports / hotfixes to consider:
- BACKEND-2381: KV cache handling edge-case on quantized models -> backport candidate to stable-2026.03.
- INFRA-991: sidecar timeouts too low for long-context requests -> PR open, needs quick test.
- TODO: decide whether to include BACKEND-2381 in this cutover or schedule for next patch.

Communication reminders:
- Slack: post start message to #prod-release at T+0 (template below).
- PagerDuty: ensure oncall is listed for escalation (Aisha).
- Customer comms: product will send heads-up email to customers in next release window (post-prod stable).

Slack start template (paste to #prod-release):
"Starting prod cutover for 2026.03.23 at 09:00 PT. Canary at 2% -> monitoring latency & error rate. Oncall: Aisha Rao. Will post updates every 30m or on blockers."

Verification checklist (post-deploy):
- [ ] Synthetic checks (end-to-end) all pass for all critical routes.
- [ ] Spot-check 10 customer sessions for chat continuity.
- [ ] Token cost and latency per-model dashboards not degraded > 10% from baseline.
- [ ] No increase in 5xx rates; if >0.5% for 15m -> trigger rollback.

Rollback plan (if needed):
- Criteria: 5xx spike >0.5% sustained for 15m OR P95 increase >20% impacting 50%+ of traffic.
- Action: revert routing to previous model variant via routing API (route-id: r-prod-2026-03-22).
- Owner: Jordan Lee to execute revert, Aisha to monitor infra impact.
- Post-rollback: create incident ticket, notify #prod-release and escalate to eng leads.

Post-cutover tasks:
- [ ] Run full regression evals on 100% traffic over 24h.
- [ ] Collect perf metrics and commit notes to RELEASE-482.
- [ ] Schedule follow-up to fix canary P95 spike root cause (autoscaler + batching).

Open questions / TODO (notes to self):
- Should we backport BACKEND-2381 now? Risk: could introduce new perf variance.
- Need to confirm SLA wording for dedicated customers re: transient latency blips. Ping legal/product.
- Revisit canary autoscale thresholds: current policy scales based on CPU; switch to queue_depth metric?

Quick reminders / personal TODOs:
- Ping Samira to confirm canary dataset run time window (10m).
- Leave note for infra: increase sidecar timeout to 90s for next patch.
- After cutover: write short retrospective and link to Confluence.

End of scratchpad. Will update in real time during cutover.

-- Noah
